status: Cause identified and reproduced: CFS CUDA-completion yield competes with busy-polling gNB radio on the same CPU

configuration.ue: CPU srsUE with previously isolated pilot noise-estimator repair

causal_chain: The same ordinary-priority phy_worker performs CUDA completion polling and the gNB PHY tasks.
Its OFDM flush_pending_output and PUSCH cudaEventSynchronizeYielding call sched_yield when an event is not ready.
If phy_worker shares a CPU with the continuously runnable radio polling thread, yielding permits radio to occupy that CPU for milliseconds.
The PHY thread remains runnable but cannot check completion, copy/submit output, or advance to radio TX; source IQ arrives late.
Broker waits for this missing input; its unchanged one-batch catch-up bound retains excess delay in cumulative progress.

controlled_comparison.intervention: 250 ms at channel tag240: radio CPU6 in both; PHY CPU6 versus CPU7, all inside original CPU5-12 mask. Both affinities restored afterward.
controlled_comparison.connectivity: Both runs passed live gates and 30/30 segments; shared-core run intentionally violates real-time deadlines and is diagnostic, not real-time qualified.

historical_43ms.return_addresses: Two captured return PCs resolve to these exact CUDA wait functions with one consistent ELF load bias 0xb48143f40000.
historical_43ms.limitation: No scheduler ownership was captured in that historical run. New scheduler traces plus co-location/separation intervention prove the mechanism; attribution of the precise historical peer is an inference.

measurement.interpretation: The -0.605 us tag-endpoint phase difference is not accumulated lag. No raw metric was rounded or rewritten.

remedy.primary: Keep busy radio and CUDA-completion PHY worker on separate reserved CPUs within the existing gNB allocation. A common allowed affinity range does not ensure separation.
remedy.other: Replace unconditional OS yield in very short GPU completion polls with an explicitly bounded waiting policy, validated separately; this turn does not ship a gNB binary patch.
remedy.trap: OCUDU_CUDA_SYNC_SPIN_US is not a no-yield spin option in this source: its spin loop still calls sched_yield, and low_phy_tx wait_event_yielding unconditionally yields.
remedy.compatibility: No IQ sample, CUDA kernel, ZMQ wire format, sample rate, or timing metric changed in the core-affinity comparison.

rejected_or_unproven.analyzer: Historical unpinned analysis overlaps the old burst, but an identical controlled analyzer rerun did not reproduce lag. It is not established as the initiating actor.
rejected_or_unproven.gpu_execution: Device completion timestamps were not measured. CPU ownership and the affinity intervention establish the excess host scheduling component without equating yield wall time with kernel execution.

artifacts.first_attempt: r1 live gate passed, but its observer failed on tracefs open flags; excluded from the scheduler comparison.
artifacts.cleanup: All owned capture/reservation/workload processes stopped, affinity changes restored, private uprobes removed, HTML documents unchanged.
